name: Clothing Consistency Analysis
description: Detects temporal inconsistencies in clothing patterns, textures, and physical behavior in video.
useCase: Identifying AI-generated full-body videos through clothing rendering anomalies
mechanism: Tracks clothing pattern details (stripes, logos, text), wrinkle dynamics, and fabric physics across frames. AI-generated videos often exhibit pattern warping, disappearing details, physically incorrect fabric behavior, or texture flickering on clothing.
source: Khormali, A. & Yuan, J. (2022) - DFDT: An End-to-End DeepFake Detection Framework, Applied Sciences
algorithm: Texture Tracking + Pattern Consistency + Physical Simulation Comparison
parameters: Texture features: LBP + Gabor, Pattern tracking: template matching, Physics: cloth simulation comparison
strengths:
• Works on full-body video
• Detects non-facial deepfake artifacts
• Pattern consistency is hard for AI
• Complements face-focused methods
limitations:
• Plain clothing reduces effectiveness
• Rapid movement blurs patterns
• Style transfer can affect textures
• Limited public benchmarks for evaluation

references.title: Khormali, A. & Yuan, J. (2022). DFDT: An End-to-End DeepFake Detection Framework. Applied Sciences.
Tolosana, R. et al. (2020). DeepFakes and Beyond: A Survey of Face Manipulation and Fake Detection. Information Fusion.
Rana, M.S. et al. (2022). Deepfake Detection: A Systematic Literature Review. IEEE Access.
